name: python heredoc helper function writing through a parameter
command:
W=wt/pkg; cd $W && python3 - <<'EOF'
def sub(path, old, new, count=1):
    s=open(path).read()
    assert s.count(old)==count, (path, old)
    open(path,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
sub('internal/launch/a.go','x','y')
EOF
